name: open-exposure-bond-nonblocking-window-window-integral
represents: A locked bond required to cover current open exposure plus the maximum payout of the instance, an optimistic claim with an assertion bond and a dispute bond during a liveness window, and an explicit rule that the window does not block the next action.
profile_v1_violations: the assertion and dispute bonds are posted per claim by whoever claims; there is no registered verifier set, so minVerifiers >= 3 * maxAssignments + 5 has no meaning here
the bond is recomputed against a running exposure register, which the profile has no field for; the profile reserves a fixed sellerPenalty instead

fairbind_parameters.deferPolicy_note: Actions are executed and admitted before any claim exists, and the window's deadlines govern only the settlement instance, not the next action. This is the defining property of the arm.

sellerBond.E_open_semantics: the sum of every instance admitted and still inside its challenge window at the moment of the check; recomputed at every admission, this acts as a rate limit over the window

rateCap.note: No rate limit and no volume ceiling. The window explicitly does not gate the next action.

verifier.note: Bonded parties exist, but they are self-selected claimants and disputers, not checkers assigned to a selected transaction. Detection is challenge-driven.

cannot_express: sampling: nothing selects a transaction, so an undisputed fault is never examined
an assigned, penalized checker: bonds attach to whoever chooses to speak, so silence has no cost and a fault nobody notices has no procedure
a rate cap of any kind, which is stated as a feature rather than an omission
a holding period: nothing is held, so the window sum limits admission instead of holding proceeds
harness_special_cases: the exposure register must be recomputed at every admission, exactly as the arm specifies, so that the arm is tested at its best rather than as a straw configuration; the leak must come from the accumulation semantics, not from a lazy implementation

record both quantities separately: the bond required at the moment of the check, and the value that settled between the check and the verdict. Their gap is the measured quantity this arm exists to produce
detection requires a disputer; the complaint policy belongs in the scenario file, and a run with no disputer must be labelled 'undetected by construction'
the D-sweep does not apply; emit one point at D = 0 and mark that the arm's own text forbids the window from gating the next action
scenarios F4, S1, S2, S3 have no procedure; score 'undefined'

expected_outcome.d_sweep: Flat at D = 0, as in B7a; the difference from B7a is in admission, not in holding.

cheater_scenarios.steady_cheat: Under the window reading the bond must cover everything admitted inside the window, so admission is refused once the window sum reaches the bond minus P_max. The uncovered accumulation of the balance reading does not arise; the leak is bounded by the bond and the arm behaves like a rate limit tied to the bond.
cheater_scenarios.S5_burst: The burst is refused once the window sum reaches the bond; no linear growth with the burst multiple.
cheater_scenarios.S6_patient_defector: Patience buys nothing beyond the bond: the defector is refused once the window sum reaches the bond minus P_max.

expected_outcome.honest_seller_cost: Higher than B7a: an honest seller at rate Lambda must post about Lambda * v * window + P_max or be refused.
expected_outcome.role: Second reading of the same arm; if B7a leaks and B7b does not, the leak comes from the reading of E_open and results must say so.

operating_point_note: Values written "op:<expr>" are read from experiments/operating-point.json (see experiments/controller/operating_point.py); this file keeps no copy of g, v, p, L or the rates.
changes_from_source: P_max 100000000 (100 USDC) -> op:v, the largest payout of one instance at the shared operating point
one of two readings of E_open; the other reading is B7a
complaintPolicy fixed to the value shared with B6
